title: The tangent plane of a locally radially invariant C¹ surface at p is 2-dimensional and contains p
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, every M ⊆ ℝ^P that is an embedded C¹ 2-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 2 M), every p ∈ M and every ρ > 0 such that t·x ∈ M whenever x ∈ M ∩ B_ρ(p), t > 0 and t·x ∈ B_ρ(p): the linear span Q := span(tangentSpace M p) has dimension 2 and p ∈ Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 2 M → p ∈ M → 0 < ρ → (∀ x ∈ M ∩ ball p ρ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t • x ∈ ball p ρ → t • x ∈ M) → Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M p)) = 2 ∧ p ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M p)
